definition: Wildly unreasonable or excessive in a way that is hard to justify.
author: Joseph Sheridan Le Fanu
quote: What she did tell me amounted, in my unconscionable estimation—to nothing.
example_sentence: Making staff work unpaid overtime is unconscionable.
